# Reports: Get Submitted File Reports

Area overview and notes: [reports.md](../reports.md)

`GET /reports/submitted-files/{fileId}` · tenant-scoped token

Returns presigned download URLs for the reports a submission produced, by kind.

URLs expire after fifteen minutes. Call this route again for fresh ones rather than storing them.

**Path parameters**

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `fileId` | The unique identifier (UUID) for the submission, as carried on its events. |

**Response 200**: Where the reports for this submission can be downloaded.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data` | object | Yes |  |
| `data.file_id` | string (uuid) | Yes | The identifier for the submitted file. Carried on every event for the drop, and what the reports route takes. |
| `data.reports` | object | Yes | A report kind the submission has nothing for is absent rather than empty. |
| `data.reports.errors` | array of string | No | Validation findings. One per half of the submission that had any. |
| `data.reports.form_generation` | array of string | No | Per-account form generation outcomes. One per generation batch, so a large submission has several. |

**Errors:** 400 Bad Request · 401 Unauthorized · 404 No submission with that id in this organization. · 429 Too Many Requests
